name: Warren County, VA
findings: Warren County has 148 nonprofit organizations. 62 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 50 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Warren County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 17 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 6 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do social and fraternal organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?
